label: Claude Desktop — Code tab
description: The REAL Claude desktop app, Code tab (built from actual screenshots): light bone theme, white sidebar with the Home/Code toggle, '+ New session', numbered Recents list (active highlighted, optional live status dots), 'Relaunch to update' card and account row; main pane with session title + repo chip, claude.ai-style conversation (user bubbles right, Claude prose left, tool cards with green/red diffs, the lone orange ✳ working spinner), and the 'Type / for commands' composer with the Auto pill and model label. SCRIPTED performable surface -- the fleet story: switch-session / session-status while a live session performs. Camera anchors: sessions, transcript, input.

sessions.label: Sidebar Recents: [{title, repo?, status?: 'working'|'input'|'done'}]. Status renders a small live dot on the row (orange/amber/green); omit for plain rows like the real app at rest.

repo.label: Repo chip beside the pane title (e.g. 'media-producer-mcp'); per-session via sessions[].repo

history.label: Transcript blocks at open: [{type: 'user'|'text'|'tool', ...}] -- tool takes {tool, target, result, diff}

model_label.label: Model name right of the composer (default 'Fable 5')

script.label: The full performance: type-prompt {text}, send-prompt (posts as a right-aligned user bubble), working {text?} (the lone orange ✳; auto-removed by the next tool-call/respond), stop-working, tool-call {tool, target, result, diff?, then_working?} (light tool card with ⎿ result + green/red diff), respond {text, duration?} (streams Claude prose word by word; **bold** and `code`), claude-text {text}, switch-session {index, history?, clear?} (sidebar highlight moves, pane swaps), session-status {index, status: 'working'|'input'|'done'} (live dot appears on a Recents row). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (sessions, transcript, input).

script_actions.description: Post the typed prompt as a user bubble
The lone orange ✳ spinner (the real app's thinking indicator)
Light tool card: ⏺ Tool(target), ⎿ result, optional green/red diff
Stream Claude's answer word by word
Move the sidebar highlight and swap the pane to that session's transcript
A live status dot appears/changes on a Recents row (working/input/done) -- a parallel agent finishing while you watch another
